### Release Notes

<details>
<summary>moby/sys (github.com/moby/sys/capability)</summary>

### [`v0.5.0`](https://redirect.github.com/moby/sys/releases/tag/capability/v0.5.0): capability v0.5.0

##### Breaking changes

- Go 1.24 or later is now required. ([#​264](https://redirect.github.com/moby/sys/issues/264))

##### Fixed

- [LastCap] no longer reads `/proc/sys/kernel/cap_last_cap`, querying the
  kernel via `prctl(PR_CAPBSET_READ)` instead. This makes the package work
  when `/proc` is not mounted, and fixes a possible panic or infinite loop
  when `/proc/sys/kernel/cap_last_cap` contains a bogus value (for example,
  if something is mounted over `/proc`). ([#​265](https://redirect.github.com/moby/sys/issues/265), [#​269](https://redirect.github.com/moby/sys/issues/269))

##### Changed

- Minor code cleanups. ([#​187](https://redirect.github.com/moby/sys/issues/187))

For the complete list of changes, see [capability/CHANGELOG.md](capability/CHANGELOG.md).
